verdict.text: Coiled bars broke their own ±1σ band 45% of the time against 26% for calm bars (+19 pts) — the squeeze thesis holds.

explainer: The honest test is not whether high scores move more in absolute percent — the score deliberately selects low-volatility names, which always move less in raw terms. The thesis is expansion: does the move break out beyond the stock's own compressed band? That is the expansion multiple (realized ÷ expected) and the band-break rate.
caveat: Overlapping forward windows make these observations autocorrelated, so read the percentages as descriptive rather than as independent-sample statistics. The score flags where a relative expansion is likelier — never its direction. Past behaviour does not guarantee future results.
